FixtureType.Description: COLORado PXL Bar 8 is a motorized, outdoor-ready tilting batten with capabilities to zoom for tight and wide pixel-mappable looks. This bright, moving pixel bar also features seamless edge-to-edge mounting and includes virtual gobo and movement macros with separate foreground and background color control for more design options than ever before. Slotted Omega brackets make it quick and easy to hang the fixture on truss. The COLORado PXL Bar 8 can also be positioned on the ground, which allows for a variety of different light angles. The power is in your hands and the possibilities are endless!
